dataset: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 (official per-unit train/test split)
methodology: Sliding 30-cycle windows over 14 informative sensors, min-max scaled on train only. Piecewise-linear RUL target capped at 125. Evaluated on the last window of each test engine vs RUL_FD001. No random split, no temporal leakage. All values measured on this machine.
